page_summary:
This section gathers PKD's own mentions of Ubik across PKD-authored primary writings in the archive. The catalog records 50 detected title mentions in 6 PKD-authored documents. 

The represented source types here include letters (39), primary text (11). The heaviest source documents are Claudia Bush Letters (34), Ubik: The Screenplay (8), Letter on Star Wars (3). 

Nearby language repeatedly turns on which, screenplay, what, and time. 

The mention list is organized by source document so readers can move directly from each remark to the underlying text.
